junro.title: Order-Bias Probe — the presented order's bias measured over the tree's own stamped votes (Wang et al.'s flips-on-swap, the birth store's R7 priced deferral revisited behind the verified stamps): the datum measured, the cure earned by the datum if the datum is measured, the null result a finding never a failure — the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: THE INWARD DIRECTION (Q-ci-surface ruling R3, 2026-11-23): after CI — auth first (the write-exposure cure, DONE at the collaborator's ruling 2026-11-25), the order-bias probe second, outward/PyPI after inward; the >100-item scale fence held (adaptive scheduling banked until the real earn)

THE PRICED DEFERRAL REVISITED (the birth store's Q-problem-space ruling R7): the both-directions order-bias probe (Wang et al.'s flips-on-swap, validated) is a PRICED DEFERRAL behind the schema's stamps — revisit at a measured bias datum or an LLM-dominant birth session; the presentation_order datum non-optional per the prior-art's field schema (the anti-order-bias datum); the scheduler's seed carried NOW so the widening is additive, never rework (the core store's fence doctrine)

THE AUTH EFFORT'S GROUND (the close's naming, 2026-11-25): the verified stamps (the class on the key record, the id from the key, the self-claim dead at every authenticated door) make every vote's provenance citable — the probe's data now trustworthy by construction; the member tier that will run it authenticated at --serve and trusted at stdio by named ruling

THE TREE'S OWN GROUND: the vote data whole (the runs on disk — the stamped votes: comparator_id, comparator_class, the pair, the winner, the recorded_at; the presentation order the schedule's canonical id-sorted form at birth); the tally's purity (the permuted-multiset byte-identity — the order-independence already held at the count); the corroboration floor (>=1 human AND >=1 llm per pair — the classes citable per vote); the floor at 336, the CI live, the auth built whole

the standing laws carried: the seat-authored report (R6/R11), the per-step dispatch (R8, the file-unit), the two-lane form, the ThreePart, the census-first composition, the claims lane (extract -> research -> verify -> rule), the implementation-walk law (R4), the free-tier spirit

structure.purpose: THE CENSUS (the measurement's ground, the census-first law): FOUR parallel ungated packets over the probe's own ground — tansa's vote-corpus census (the runs on disk whole: the votes, their stamps [the verified ids and classes], the pairs, the winners, the presentation order the schedule's canonical form carries; the corpus's size and shape); shindan's honest-conditions diagnosis (what the corpus can and cannot support — the sample sizes, the confounds, the classes' balance); rikai's mechanism maps (the judgment's chain — the scheduler's canonical order, the tally's counting, the seed's shuffle mode [the widening's additive form], the vote path's every seam); keisan's statistical arithmetic (the forms' power at the corpus's real size — the flips-on-swap rate, the significance thresholds, the both-orders experiment's demanded sample, the retrospective vs prospective prices); the claims lane at any fresh literature (Wang et al. VERIFIED at the birth store — any fresh claim its own verdict)
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green — the route validated; the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition

structure.purpose: THE DESIGN (the measurement's shape): suisen's measurement design (the datum's form, the threshold, the experiment's shape — the retrospective and/or the prospective each priced; the classes' slicing; the free-tier cost) + hyoka's adversarial pass (the design attacked: the confounds, the p-hacking forms, the datum's honesty) + MOHO'S DATUM STORY (the measurement walked as the story it will tell — the datum's reading, the null's face) + togo's gated synthesis closing G-PROBE-DESIGN at the collaborator's ruling — the design judged publicly right: the shape honest at the corpus's real size, the no-anchoring discipline held
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green and the census's packets landed whole (the corpus, the conditions, the mechanisms, the arithmetic)

structure.purpose: THE MEASURE (the datum itself): the measurement run per the approved design — jikko's instrument (the probe's tooling per the design's ruling: the retrospective computation over the corpus's stamps and/or the prospective experiment's minted run), the run's record whole (the raw votes, the computed statistic, the threshold's comparison), kensho's independent verification (the datum recomputed — the numbers' second eyes), the floor held (the tree unbroken); closing G-DATUM at the collaborator's ruling on the measured record: the cure FIRES or the NULL STANDS
structure.entry_condition: G-PROBE-DESIGN is green — the measurement dispatches only per the approved design

structure.purpose: THE CURE (the build set the datum earns, named not pinned): the units the measured record rules — both-orders averaging at the tally, the presentation-shuffle mode (the scheduler's seed already carried), the early-stop rules, or NOTHING (the null standing — the finding carried, no build forced); each earned unit its two-lane brief -> spec -> build per the standing form, one file per dispatch (R8), kensho's independent verification per build gate, MOHO'S IMPLEMENTATION WALK at any user-facing unit (R4), the floor held; the units mint per the datum's ruling at their build-adds (the auto-stamp the pair's sole creator)
structure.entry_condition: G-DATUM is green and its ruling names the earned set — no cure dispatch fires on a null

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry — the measured truth carried whole, the next era named per the inward direction [outward after inward], the banked shapes carried), the done call at the collaborator's ruling
structure.entry_condition: the route's gates closed green (the datum's verdict carried whole; the cure's units if earned, green) and the collaborator has called the close

conditions: the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: the five stages [census -> design -> measure -> cure -> close], the four gates, the three increments, the eight ungated placements) — the measurement-first mandate realized: the stages measure before any cure, the datum's gate the cure's only key, the null result a finding never a failure

every choice cites its ruling: the convening ruling (the measurement first, the cure earned by the datum, the null a finding) + R3's inward direction (auth DONE, the probe second, outward after) + R7's priced deferral (Wang et al.'s flips-on-swap revisited behind the verified stamps) + the auth close's ground (the provenance citable by construction) + the standing laws (the census-first, the claims lane, the two-lane form, R8, R6/R11, R4, the free-tier spirit) + the budget-curve and ci precedents (the measurement class, the scaled-down-without-flattening form)
the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation; the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

the design landed: togo's gated synthesis over the census (the vote corpus, the honest conditions, the mechanisms, the statistical arithmetic) + suisen's measurement design + hyoka's adversarial pass + MOHO'S DATUM STORY — the measurement's shape whole: the datum's form (the flips-on-swap rate or the ruled statistic), the threshold, the retrospective vs the prospective experiment each priced (the run the probe may mint, its cost), the classes' slicing (human/llm per the verified stamps), the claims lane at any fresh literature

the statistical form ruled at its own weight: keisan's arithmetic the ground the design must fit (the corpus's real size, the power, the significance threshold — the datum's form honest at the data's size, never smoothed); the no-anchoring discipline held (the datum reported at its own weight); the scope fence held (the probe measures the judgment's order-sensitivity, never re-proves the count's order-independence — R12's byte-identity not re-earned)
the collaborator rules the design publicly right on the full record — no measurement dispatch fires before it is green

the measurement landed per the approved design: the datum measured over the ruled form (the retrospective corpus and/or the prospective experiment per the design's ruling), the run's record whole (the raw votes, the stamps, the computed statistic, the threshold's comparison — every number citable to its vote), kensho's independent verification green (the datum recomputed — the numbers' second eyes)

the datum reported at its own weight: the statistic, its threshold, its verdict — the null a finding never a failure; the classes' slicing carried (human/llm per the verified stamps); the honest statement named either way

the collaborator rules on the measured record: the cure FIRES (the build set earned — both-orders averaging, the presentation-shuffle mode, the early-stop rules, named per the datum's shape) or the NULL STANDS (the finding carried, the deferral's revisit honest) — the build set named not pinned, minting per the ruling

hansei's retro landed (the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named); the effort's records landed (the CONTINUATION entry — the landing state named honestly: the measured truth carried whole [the datum's verdict and its price], the next era named per the inward direction [outward after inward], the banked shapes carried)
the done call at the collaborator's ruling — the route's status set done at the ruling, Q-order-bias resolved at the record (the truth measured, the cure earned or the null standing)

amendments.what: THE CENSUS'S ARITHMETIC UNDER VERIFICATION — the collaborator's trust challenge (2026-11-25) answered with evidence, and the design stage HELD until the verified numbers land. THE GRANT MAP PINNED (tansa's seat-grant census): keisan carries the calculate tool at every in-tree layer (opencode.json:188 the runtime permission map the live session launched under; the generated seat prompt keisan.md:26; 12 of 13 seats carry it, shinko the deliberate exception per the birth ruling), tansa carries it too (the rows byte-identical on the calculate axis); the authored source yaml at hikari the ONE unread layer (the external-directory boundary) — the collaborator's hikari contact the source-layer settlement (the drift question: if hikari's prioritree-seats.yaml lacks keisan's calculate row, the in-tree allow is source-vs-emission drift the scaffold's --check exists to catch). THE REAL FAULT THE CHALLENGE SURFACED: the census legs' raw counts disagree by ONE human vote (tansa: human prefer-a 6/14, total 11/11; shindan + keisan: 7/14, total 12/10; the llm 5/8 agrees everywhere) — at least one leg misread a vote, and the reports carry no instrument traces (the provenance unauditable from the record) — FR-MEM-0036 filed. THE VERIFICATION dispatched (census/statistical-arithmetic's chain: keisan re-running the recount at the calculate tool, the discrepancy settled vote-by-vote, every headline number tool-carried or stepwise-derived with the tool checking each supported step — the six-op engine's boundary named honestly); NO DESIGN-LEG DISPATCH FIRES until the verified numbers land — the design gate's own condition (the statistical form ruled at its own weight) demands instrument-trusted ground.
amendments.why: the no-claim-without-evidence law held at our own numbers as at any outside claim — the claims lane turned inward: the collaborator's catch earned its keep (a one-vote misread was consuming into the design stage's ground); the design stage holds on unverified arithmetic, never fires on it — and the grant question settled at the evidence (the runtime map), not the assumption (either side's)
